reason: I cancel subscriptions on principle, and I eat out maybe twice a week, so paying $39.99 a year for something I'd open a few times a month feels like a lot. I'd use the free scans and the top 3 picks and see if that's enough.
objection: Why pay a yearly fee for an app I'd use twice a month, when a trial can quietly turn into a charge I forget to cancel?
would_change_my_mind: A one-time price with no renewal, or proof over a few free scans that it catches the dishes I actually order and isn't just flagging everything red.
